summary: Feed s131_double is degraded: 100% of packets are untagged so required VLANs 10,20 are missing, and 93.1% encrypted share exceeds NDR 90% tolerance, reducing payload visibility.

findings.root_cause: VLAN tags are stripped upstream - 100% of packets arrived untagged despite NDR requiring VLANs 10 and 20. Most likely the SPAN/mirror source or packet broker is configured to strip 802.1Q headers or the trunk is not forwarding those VLANs to the tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR loses segment/tenant context for VLANs 10 and 20, cannot apply VLAN-aware policies and misses detection coverage on those segments despite needing full payload and both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve 802.1Q tags end-to-end from TAP through packet broker to NDR so required VLANs are visible for detection and filtering.

findings.root_cause: 93.1% of bytes are encrypted (threshold 90%), indicating predominantly TLS traffic forwarded without decryption. No broker-side TLS visibility is in place.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload for deep inspection; with >93% encrypted, payload-based detection and anomaly analysis are blind to malicious content inside TLS.

recommended_fix.why: Decrypt selectively at the packet broker/TLS visibility appliance and forward cleartext copy to the NDR to restore payload visibility while respecting privacy/compliance policy.
